title: NightWatch Fixture Manifest
description: Index of all fixture files. Each fixture file has: object, schema ($id), positive[] (must validate) and negative[] (must be REJECTED; each entry carries 'violated_rule' stating the violated contract rule). Fields starting with '_' inside positive instances (e.g. '_transition', '_semantic_category') are fixture annotations stripped by the verifier before validation. ALL DATA IS SYNTHETIC: no real credentials, real IPs or real token-shaped values; synthetic markers use 'synthetic-' prefixes and obviously-fake ULIDs.
annotation_convention: Underscore-prefixed keys inside positive instances are metadata for the verifier and are stripped before schema validation; negative instances live under {violated_rule, instance} pairs and are validated as-is (expected to fail).
data_policy: All values are synthetic. ULIDs are hand-crafted valid Crockford-Base32 strings; checksums are fake 64-hex strings; timestamps are fixed ISO-8601 UTC values for deterministic verification.

state_machine_fixtures.notes: All 13 legal transitions of the §7.2 machine (including blocked recovery and the WorkRequest §5.2 inconclusive→retest_pending edge) have positive fixtures; 5 illegal transitions are covered as negatives (>= 3 required).

error_semantic_fixtures.notes: Each required semantic category has >= 1 positive envelope fixture; '_semantic_category' annotations drive the verifier's category-coverage check.

security_negatives: objects/execution_request.json negative[0]: lowercase credential name in allowlist rejected
objects/registry_entry.json negative[1]: URL value in base_url_env rejected (must be reference name)
